Resolve the SLURM resources for a given model

resolve_slurm_resources.Rd

Merges the default block with any models[[model]] override, per-field — an override only replaces the fields it names, leaving the rest of default untouched. Field names deliberately match crew.cluster::crew_options_slurm()'s arguments (partition, cpus_per_task, memory_gigabytes_per_cpu, time_minutes) so build_slurm_controllers() can spread the result straight into it.

Usage

resolve_slurm_resources(model, resources = read_slurm_resources())

Arguments

model

Model identifier to look up an override for

resources

A list as returned by read_slurm_resources()

Value

A named list of resolved SLURM options
